text:
Predicates:
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Japanese(y) ::: y is a Japanese company.
Top10List(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
IncludedInTop10(x) ::: x is included in the Top 10 list.

Premises:
∀x (Top10List(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ Japanese(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) → IncludedInTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
IncludedInTop10(theLegendOfZelda)
